statement.p: The number of bacteria in a culture is given by the function \displaystyle{n}{\left({t}\right)}={935}{e}^{{{0.3}{t}}} where \displaystyle{t} is measured in hours and the result is in grams.
What is the initial mass of the culture (at t=0)?
How much bacteria will the culture contain at time t=5?

solution.p: The initial amount is the coefficient in front, because when \displaystyle{t}={0} the second factor is just one. So the initial amount is 935.
When \displaystyle{t}={5}, the amount is expected to be \displaystyle{935}{e}^{{{0.3}\cdot{5}}}={4190.3792807661}.
